titulo_video: HAS THE HEIR LOST IT?! THE MOST BIZARRE REVELATION IN THE MANHWA! - Ch 3

locucoes.text: I can't believe this is happening right now...
SORRY...
FOR EARLIER.
What could be going through his head?
I GOT ANGRY AND...
THERE'S NO MASTER WHO APOLOGIZES TO THEIR BELONGINGS, RIGHT?
I'M THE MASTER'S BELONGING. HUH?
Look at the weight of that stare, people, because things just went sour!
CAN I... SHOW YOU?
W-WHAT ARE YOU DOING?!!
I'LL SHOW YOU.
Damn, now the heart's racing like crazy!
MY 'RESOLVE'...
AS A SLAVE.
And brace yourselves, because the chaos of this chapter is just getting started!
What have I gotten myself into...?
After all, in the shadows of this room, secrets are coming to light!
RESOLVE?
I just want you to understand once and for all...
The tension's thick enough to cut with a knife, hold onto that pressure!
Don't look away now, focus on the danger!
EEK?!
SO...
I'LL BEGIN...
My God, stop everything, because this scene is way too heavy!
Just see the level of insanity this webtoon has reached, folks!
My service.
Yeah it's unbelievable, things got really crazy for real!
P... Please,
PLEASE, STOP.
MASTER?
IT'S AS IF YOUR OWN WILL... DOESN'T MATTER AT ALL.
IF YOU SEE A MAN'S DICK FOR THE FIRST TIME...
Y-YOU SHOULD...
TOUCH...
WITH... YOUR MOUTH...
I'm paralyzed, can't believe what I just heard!
THAT'S WHAT... THEY TOLD ME...
...THEY TOLD ME... HUH?
DID YOU DO THAT... ...WITH MY FATHER TOO?
...WHAT ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT? THIS IS...
Answer me right now to my face if you've got the guts!
The mood's on fire and the abyss is right up ahead!
TAKING ADVANTAGE OF THIS AND THAT...
DOING THIS TO ME...
I DON'T THINK IT'S RIGHT.
HUH?
I SWEAR...
I NEVER SHARED A BED WITH MY MASTER'S FATHER.
NEVER. WHAT...
YOU'RE... ALL MY EDUCATION HAPPENED USING TOYS.
I WAS 'RAISED' SOLELY
With the purpose of being 'devoted' to you.
I am...
Yours, master.
A subtle smile that hides a thousand monsters behind it!
Meanwhile, the moon witnesses another terrible secret on this cold night.
HAA... I can't think about all this anymore.
For now, since it's too cold, I brought her back with me...
What... does God expect me to do...?
Every drop of water echoes like a clock counting down to tragedies.
The hot bath can barely wash away the guilt and confusion!
Submerged in this silence, the thoughts scream way too loud.
CERTAINLY...
ONCE YOU MEET HIM...
HE'LL BE MORE TRUSTWORTHY...
THAN YOU THINK.
I know... about that...
Soon the clouds cover the moon and the mystery only thickens!
Really? Good thing I have exactly one extra blanket.
I don't mind if we sleep together...
Since you said you didn't bring anything, I gave you my shirt...
Look at the guy's flustered face, turned all red!
ARE YOU REALLY SURE IT'S OKAY FOR YOU?
AS LONG AS IT'S YOURS, I'LL BE HAPPY TO RECEIVE ANYTHING, MASTER. I SEE... Again with the master thing...
ANYWAY, I'M GOING TO SLEEP NOW. GET SOME REST. WE'LL TALK ABOUT THE REST TOMORROW.
Her patience is enough to send chills down your spine!
The heir's mental battery died, the boy's burnt out!
Take a deep breath and try to shut off that bombarded brain!
Not even with closed eyes does peace come say hi!
TODAY WAS A TOTALLY CHAOTIC DAY.
And when everything seems calm, danger lurks in the shadows!
After all, those streaks in the background already warn that the bomb's about to drop!
But what kind of sinister smile is that appearing out of nowhere, folks?!
And with those red inscriptions glowing, the ritual is finally about to begin!
WOW...
Because someone's prowling around the edge of that dark bed!
The danger's right next to me and I'm lying here clueless!
THERE'S AN UNKNOWN WOMAN THERE.
IT'S NOT LIKE I COULD DO ANYTHING ALONE, ANYWAY...
Hold your breath so you don't attract the boogeyman!
SERIOUSLY...
In this instant, the sound of breathing cuts through the silence of the night!
That way, each gasp is a direct shot to our psyche!
And it comes with a muffled sigh that chills you to the bone!
After all, lying there in the shadows, what could she be plotting?
Eyes popped out, the shock was officially real!
What am I hearing right now...
Aren't those moans?
Master...
Could it be... right now... that woman...
Ahhh...
Good Lord of outrageous manhwas!
The situation heated up in an unbelievable way!
SHE'S...
The brain completely froze with this vision from beyond!
MASTURBATING?!
